## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced by project-tier PLINY-ariadne via HUMAN_relay_user_polybius_ariadne_distribution_and_mcp_2026-05-13.md (Finding 4: substrate-tier propagation gap).

Stoa-team agents at substrate tier do not currently have explicit Ariadne-component knowledge. Other Stoa-team projects encountering an agent-memory-substrate or vector-search need have no canonical path that says "Ariadne exists; here is how to evaluate fit; here is the working access model."

## The substrate-tier facts that need canonical home

Three load-bearing facts about Ariadne for substrate POLYBIUS / substrate-deployed agents:

1. **Identity:** Ariadne is an agent-memory substrate component (NOT primarily search-over-tickets). Markdown extraction is a side benefit; the core value is durable agent-readable knowledge with retrieval. Published as `ariadne-core-client` on PyPI; deployed at `ariadne-core-production.up.railway.app`.

2. **Access model:** REST API + `ariadne` CLI driven via Bash/shell tool. **MCP is non-functional in practice** despite `mcp_server.py` + README references. The `mcp_server.py` + `claude mcp add` instructions are aspirational/broken. Agents drive Ariadne via `ariadne search`, `ariadne login` (Auth0 PKCE → OS keyring), `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" .../api/bw/projects/<slug>/...`.

3. **Fit criteria:** When a Stoa-team project needs persistent agent-readable substrate that survives session boundaries + supports retrieval — Ariadne is the canonical choice. When the project's substrate needs are ticket-shape only (parent + blocks + comments + history) — bw alone is sufficient.

## Substrate touch-points

Three plausible homes:

- `substrate/skills/ariadne-onboarding/SKILL.md` (new skill) — agents read on activation; binds fit-evaluation + access-model + getting-started
- `substrate/memories/ariadne_substrate_component.md` (new substrate-tier memory if substrate has memory canon) — propagated to all substrate-deployed instances
- `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — section on "Ariadne integration discipline" analogous to existing §12 bw cookbook

Recommend: `substrate/skills/ariadne-onboarding/SKILL.md`. The skill model is what already exists for `ariadne-core-walkthrough` / `install` / `deploy` in the project repo; substrate-tier mirror keeps the pattern consistent.

## Gauntlet

DAEDALUS + ADA + CATO. ~80-150 LOC of skill prose. Should reference project-tier memories at `~/.claude/projects/.../memory/` (`project_ariadne_identity.md` + `project_ariadne_distribution_model.md` + `project_ariadne_access_model.md`) as source material.

## Sequencing

P2. Substrate-canon gap with real propagation impact — other Stoa-team projects spinning up don't currently have a path to discover Ariadne as a usable substrate component. Arc 25+ candidate.
